headline: Large caps rose while *smallcaps sank 1.10%*
subline: FIIs bought Rs 4,864.68 Cr. DIIs sold Rs 3,519.05 Cr. Only 792 stocks rose.
hero_text: The broader market lagged the Nifty. Smallcap 250 fell 0.94% and Midcap 150 fell 0.41%, while FIIs bought and DIIs sold.
why_head: Why the Nifty rose, breadth fell

why.title: Large caps carried the index
why.desc: Nifty rose 146.80 points to 25,291.10. 31 of its 50 stocks gained.

why.title: FIIs ran a big cash bid
why.desc: FIIs bought Rs 4,864.68 Cr in cash. DIIs sold Rs 3,519.05 Cr.

why.title: The wider market sold off
why.desc: 1,937 stocks fell against 792 that rose. Smallcap 250 lost 0.94%.

why.title: Fear edged up on a green day
why.desc: India VIX rose 1.18% to 15.68, near the middle of its 20 session range.

sector_reasons.FMCG: ITC and Nestle led the lift
sector_reasons.Bank: Large lenders held a steady bid
sector_reasons.Private Bank: Private lenders firmed with the index
sector_reasons.Pharma: Weakest sector as Laurus Labs slid
sector_reasons.Metal: Tata Steel and Hindalco led the drop
sector_reasons.Realty: Sold off with the smallcap tape

bonus_text: FIIs bought Rs 4,864.68 Cr in cash while DIIs sold Rs 3,519.05 Cr. Foreign money outweighed domestic selling.
movers_note_gainers: Max Healthcare led at 6.63%. ITC and Tata Consumer each added over 3.5%.
movers_note_losers: TMPV fell 8.70%, the deepest drop. Tata Steel, Maruti and Hindalco each lost over 2%.
watch_text: The Nifty weekly expiry falls tomorrow. Open interest shows the heaviest puts at 25,000 and the heaviest calls at 26,000.
lessons: Defensives led while cyclicals sagged. FMCG rose as metal, pharma and auto fell.
Foreign cash reached the large names. Midcaps and smallcaps still closed lower.
One heavy loser did not stop the index. TMPV sank and the Nifty still rose.
The Nifty closed just above the 25,200 max pain strike on expiry eve.
alert_text: The Nifty weekly expiry is tomorrow. US retail sales data lands at 23:00 IST.
cta_sub: Index up, most stocks down. Next bell is Tuesday 17 November.
next_text: Tuesday 17 November brings the Nifty weekly expiry. US retail sales follow at 23:00 IST.
